text: dsh-codex-pins（DSH 网页插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 的会话列表增加便于管理常用对话的置顶视图。它在侧边栏把置顶会话和最近会话分成两个独立区域，并在会话行和对话标题栏提供图钉操作。主要功能包括置顶与取消置顶、按最近置顶顺序排列、限制最多 50 个会话、清理已不存在的会话，以及从旧版置顶存储格式导入名单。置顶名单保存在浏览器当前源的 localStorage，可在侧边栏查看并打开置顶会话。适合希望快速回到常用 DSH 对话的用户；使用 web 客户端时无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-codex-pins adds Pinned and Recents areas to the DSH web sidebar. Pin or unpin sessions from a list row or conversation header, and reopen pinned chats. Up to 50 pins persist in browser localStorage; stale sessions are removed. No API key or external service is needed.
想把常用的 DSH 对话固定在侧边栏顶部
有没有办法把重要会话和最近聊天分开显示？
让我能从会话列表快速置顶或取消置顶一个对话
DSH 的最近会话太多，怎么把常用的几个单独留下？
希望置顶会话能在浏览器里记住，刷新后还在
让侧边栏显示独立的置顶区和最近会话区
How can I keep my frequently used DSH chats at the top?
I want pinned conversations separated from recent sessions.
Can I pin and unpin a chat directly from the sidebar?
Keep a short list of important sessions easy to reopen.
dsh-codex-pins 的功能「会话行置顶」：会话列表每行带图钉按钮，点击即可置顶或取消置顶；达到 50 个上限时给出提示。
dsh-codex-pins 的功能「置顶与最近分栏」：侧边栏分别显示置顶会话和最近会话，置顶项从最近列表隐藏，点击置顶项可打开会话。
dsh-codex-pins 的功能「保存与清理置顶」：置顶名单保存在当前浏览器源的 localStorage；会话目录就绪后清除已不存在的会话，并可读取旧格式名单。
dsh-codex-pins 使用前须知：置顶名单存放在浏览器当前源的 localStorage，按浏览器源保存；清理浏览器存储会移除这份名单。（见 client.js:11-13、127-145）

dsh-codex-pins README · dsh-codex-pins：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Codex-style **pinned sessions** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). The sidebar splits into two panes — **Pinned** and **Recents** — each with its own heading and scroll. Pinned chats do not repeat in Recents.

```
┌─ sidebar ─────────────────────┐
│  New session                  │
│                               │
│  Pinned                       │

dsh-codex-pins README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:robbyisrobby/dsh-codex-pins
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:robbyisrobby/dsh-codex-pins
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness (or DSH Desktop), then:

1. Hover a session row and click the pin.
2. Or open a session and click the pin in the conversation header.
3. The sidebar shows **Pinned** on top and **Recents** below. Click a pinned row to open it; click the pin again to move it back to Recents.

dsh-codex-pins README · Why this plugin：Community pin plugins either reorder rows inside a workspace or hide the list behind a footer panel. Codex (and ChatGPT) keep Pinned and Recents as two separate panes. That is the whole product.

dsh-codex-pins README · Behaviour：- Newest pin is listed first.
- Pins persist in `localStorage` (`dsh-codex-pins.v1`), per browser origin.
- If you previously used `dsh-session-pin`, existing local pins are imported once.
- At most 50 pins. Stale ids are dropped when the session catalog is ready.
- UI-only: no model traffic, no host HTTP routes, no session-log reads, no install scripts.

dsh-codex-pins README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-codex-pins
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-codex-pins
```

dsh-codex-pins README · Plugin markets：dsh-market and other storefronts that follow [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) pick this repository up after it is listed there. The install spec is `github:robbyisrobby/dsh-codex-pins`.
